# FasTest Inc.

> > Premium manufacturer of quick connectors, torque wrenches, and coupling solutions for HVAC-R, compressed gas, and industrial leak testing applications.

FasTest Inc. specializes in engineered connection systems including the PortMax and CoreMax product lines for HVAC service, G-Series connectors for specialty gas handling, and quick couplings for pressure and leak testing across automotive, medical gas, and fluid power industries.

## Key Topics

- Quick connectors and couplings
- HVAC-R access port installation
- Leak testing and pressure testing
- Compressed gas fill systems
- PortMax manual torque wrenches
- CoreMax seat technology
- Specialty gas handling
- Tube connections (expanded, ball-grip, ring-grip)
- ZeroMax refrigerant tools
- Industrial automation and IoT
- Medical and industrial gas
- Turbo diesel engine testing
- Water heater end-of-line testing
- ICON quick coupling technology
- GasMate connectors

## Core Products

- [Premium Quick Connectors & Couplings](https://www.fastestinc.com): Homepage: Quick connectors for HVAC-R, compressed gas & fluid power
- [PortMax™ Manual Torque Wrench](https://www.fastestinc.com/products/portmaxtm-manual-torque-wrench): PortMax Manual Torque Wrench for HVAC access port installation
- [CoreMax® Pistol Grip Torque Wrench](https://www.fastestinc.com/products/coremax-r-pistol-grip-torque-wrench): Electric pistol grip torque wrench with IoT data capture for CoreMax
- [FasTest 70 Series Quick Couplings](https://www.fastestinc.com/products/70): 70 Series quick couplings with ICON technology for external tubes
- [MBE / MRE Tube Connections](https://www.fastestinc.com/products/mbe-mre): MBE/MRE tube connection products for pressure and leak testing

## Compressed Gas Solutions

- [Compressed Gas Fill Connectors](https://www.fastestinc.com/products/compressed-gas-fill-connectors): High-pressure connectors for industrial, medical & specialty gas
- [Specialty Gas Connectors](https://www.fastestinc.com/industries/compressed-gas/specialty-gas): G-Series connectors for high-purity specialty gas cylinder filling
- [G-Series GNFF WOB](https://www.fastestinc.com/products/g-series-gnff-wob): G-Series GNFF WOB pneumatic actuator for oxygen valve connections
